verdict.rationale: The only agenticness-relevant evidence is a probe confirming Stripe hosts an official MCP server (docs.stripe.com/mcp), which could in principle let an AI agent issue natural-language-driven commands against Stripe APIs, but no evidence ties this specifically to Treasury operations (financial accounts, OutboundPayments, etc.) or shows a working example of natural-language control of Treasury features. Missing for 10: Treasury-specific MCP tool coverage, documented natural-language examples/use cases, and independent confirmation that Treasury actions can be driven conversationally.
